compiled_state.title: Add calibration-report.sh query bugs-by-channel-and-type and rule-effectiveness subs with --help schema documentation
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What / Why

Add two remaining query subs to calibration-report.sh:
- query bugs-by-channel-and-type: reads bugs filtered by --parent/tag, groups by (detected_by channel, bug type), emits JSON schema { channel, type, count }[]
- query rule-effectiveness <rule-id>: reads bugs tagged with the rule-id, joins mutation kill-rate data from mutation-history, emits JSON schema { rule_id, bug_count, kill_rate, effectiveness_score }
Also add --help output documenting all four query sub schemas so the completion-verifier's LLM can run Verify: steps against documented schema.

## Files to Modify / Create

- plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh — add bugs-by-channel-and-type sub; add rule-effectiveness <rule-id> sub; extend --help to document all query sub schemas; reuse data-access helpers from task 3ef4
- tests/scripts/test-calibration-query-bugs-channel.sh — CREATE: fixture-based test for bugs-by-channel-and-type; validates output JSON matches schema; uses --fixture flag
- tests/scripts/test-calibration-query-rule-effectiveness.sh — CREATE: fixture-based test for rule-effectiveness; validates schema fields present; uses --fixture flag

## Story DD Coverage

- dd-3: calibration-report.sh query bugs-by-channel-and-type produces output matching its documented schema for a dry-run input fixture
- dd-4: calibration-report.sh query rule-effectiveness <rule-id> produces output matching its documented schema for a dry-run input fixture
- dd-5: Each query sub's schema is documented in the script's --help output and exercised by a fixture-based test

## Given / When / Then (test approach)

Given a fixture file with 3 bugs (2 detected_by:tests+type:crash, 1 detected_by:review-llm+type:logic)
When calibration-report.sh query bugs-by-channel-and-type --fixture <file>
Then stdout is valid JSON array with entries: [{channel:tests,type:crash,count:2},{channel:review-llm,type:logic,count:1}]

Given a fixture mutation-history with rule-id r42 kill_rate 0.75 and 2 bugs tagged r42
When calibration-report.sh query rule-effectiveness r42 --fixture <file>
Then stdout JSON contains rule_id=r42, bug_count=2, kill_rate=0.75, effectiveness_score present

Given calibration-report.sh --help
Then output contains 'bugs-by-channel-and-type', 'rule-effectiveness', and 'Schema:' sections for each

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: bugs-by-channel-and-type --fixture mode groups by (channel, type), outputs valid JSON array matching {channel,type,count} schema
- AC2: rule-effectiveness <rule-id> --fixture mode joins mutation data, outputs valid JSON with {rule_id,bug_count,kill_rate,effectiveness_score}
- AC3: --help documents all four query sub schemas with 'Schema:' section headers
- AC4: Both subs reuse shared data-access helpers from task 3ef4 (no duplicated bug-list or mutation-read logic)
- AC5: Both fixture-based tests pass in isolation (no live dso ticket calls)

## Testing Mode

RED — functions do not yet exist in calibration-report.sh
